title: Encoding a bounded fan-in circuit
statement: Let $n$ and $S$ be nonnegative integers, and let $C$ be a directed acyclic Boolean circuit on $n$ input variables, with its gates in topological order and a valid output vertex. Suppose each gate has at most two inputs, its input indices are distinct, and every NOT gate has exactly one input. If the circuit size, counting the input vertices and gates, is at most $S$, then there is a code of size parameter $S$ whose evaluation agrees with $C$ on every input assignment.
